response.justification: Bogdan exceeds the 15-year engineering experience minimum and demonstrates strong technical breadth across multiple domains. However, the role specifically requires Principal Engineer-level expertise in AI strategy with demonstrated products/platforms, and his AI experience is limited to very recent infrastructure work (since April 2025) focused on tooling rather than strategic AI product development. He lacks the preferred Master's/PhD in AI-related field and shows limited cloud platform strategy experience. While his engineering fundamentals are solid and recent re:cinq work is promising, he would need significant growth in AI expertise and strategic leadership to succeed in this role.
strengths: 20 years of software engineering experience exceeds minimum 15-year requirement with consistent technical depth across web, mobile, embedded systems, and infrastructure
Strong knowledge sharing and community engagement through workshops, talks, and multiple open-source projects (GISCollective, Fluent-Asserts, Trial) demonstrating ability to inspire others
Recent full-stack experience at re:cinq including AI-agent infrastructure and MCP frameworks shows willingness to evolve into AI-focused technical work
concerns: AI expertise is very recent (April 2025) and focused on infrastructure/tooling rather than strategic product development or demonstrating 'recognized expertise in AI with demonstrated products or platforms'
Missing preferred qualifications: no Master's degree or PhD in AI-related field, limiting depth in AI/ML theory and research
Limited evidence of cloud platform strategy experience; AWS CDK mention is limited to pricing optimization at Optilyz rather than platform-level architecture or cloud product strategy
